pages.text: The first snow fell outside the window. Today, they would cut paper snowflakes and stick them on the glass.
"I will cut all the snowflakes for this window." Mio picked up scissors.
Mio folded paper and cut it. One snowflake opened wide.
Lala sat beside Mio. "Shall I cut too?" Mio covered the scissors with both hands.
Mio's fingers turned red. There were still only three snowflakes.
The window looked bare. Only three snowflakes hung there.
Mio put down the scissors. Their hands hurt too much to cut more.
Teacher Bau pointed at the window. "Whose window is this?"
Mio offered paper to Lala. "I will give you half."
Snowflakes filled the window. Snow fell outside and inside too. Mio and Lala watched shoulder to shoulder.
